extraction.Name: Charlotte Giroux Burnett (widow of John Burnett)
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: He mortgaged it and that mortgage was foreclosed just lately. We have a year from January or March I do not remember which, in which to redeem it, so we are farming it.
extraction.Occupation/Income: farming, milking cows and so forth
extraction.NOTES: Document is a questionnaire answered by Charlotte Giroux Burnette, widow of John Burnett (deceased). John Burnett died February 11, 1929. John Burnett told Charlotte he asked the Farmer (C.C. Clark) for a patent two years before he received it but his application was turned down. He left 11 children; 9 stay with Charlotte. Allottee listed as '1538 John Burnett (Dec'd).' Subscribed and sworn before S. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 14, 1929.
